   222→// different checkpoint IDs to be used when making multiple commits from a new session.

   224→	t.Parallel()
   225→
   226→	env := NewFeatureBranchEnv(t, strategy.StrategyNameManualCommit)
   227→

   246→	oldCheckpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(env.GetHeadHash())
   247→	if oldCheckpointID == "" {
   248→		t.Fatal("Old session commit should have checkpoint ID")
   249→	}
   250→	t.Logf("Old session checkpoint ID: %s", oldCheckpointID)
   251→
   252→	// Make an intermediate commit (moves HEAD forward, creates new base for new session)
   253→	env.WriteFile("intermediate.txt", "unrelated change")
   254→	env.GitAdd("intermediate.txt")
   255→	env.GitCommit("Intermediate commit (no session)")
   256→
   257→	// === Create a NEW session on the new HEAD ===
   258→	newSession := env.NewSession()
   259→	if err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(newSession.ID); err != nil {
   260→		t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit (new session) failed: %v", err)

   268→		{Path: "fileB.txt", Content: "new session file B"},
   269→	})

   271→	if err := env.SimulateStop(newSession.ID, newSession.TranscriptPath); err != nil {

   278→

   280→	env.GitCommitWithShadowHooks("Add file A from new session", "fileA.txt")
   281→	firstCheckpointID := env.GetCheckpointIDFromCommitMessage(env.GetHeadHash())
